messages.subject: error when running "calculateDiffMeth(myDiff)"
parts:
Hello,

I got the following error message when trying to run "calculateDiffMeth(myDiff)":
----------------
Error in FUN(c(0, 0.001, 0.002, 0.003, 0.004, 0.005, 0.006, 0.007, 0.008,  :
  (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
Calls: calculateDiffMeth ... fix.q.values.glm -> SLIMfunc -> sapply -> lapply -> FUN
Execution halted
-----------------

This seems to only happen when the "myDiff" object is  1) a non-CpG one (CpH type) AND ALSO  2) was generated using the unite(..., min.per.group=2L) command, that is, the number of replicates used for calculations was smaller than total number.

Do you have any suggestions / advice on that?

Thanks in advance
Alex

PS
I'm using the latest version of methylKit (the development version).

Then, I just combined the p-values from each of these subsets, and used p.adjust(..., method="BH") to calculate adjusted p-values.

The original dataset is quite big (>10M sites), so I'm not sure if it's worth trying and sending it to you..

Thanks anyway for your help
Alex
